meta.title: Linux and Proxmox commands: cheatsheet
meta.description: Linux and Proxmox VE cheatsheet: dnf, systemctl, journalctl, firewalld, LVM, rsync, and qm, pct, pvesh, vzdump for VMs and containers.
meta.intro: Package, service and log management on Fedora/RHEL (dnf, systemd), common system tools, and the Proxmox VE command line for VMs, containers, backups and the cluster.
meta.card: dnf, systemctl, journalctl, firewalld, LVM and Proxmox: qm, pct, pvesh, vzdump, pvecm.
meta.notice: Most commands need root (sudo). On Proxmox, a wrong move with qm, pct or pvecm can interrupt virtual machines: test on a test node or VM first.

entries.name: dnf install / remove / update
entries.syn: dnf install <package> | dnf remove <package> | dnf upgrade --refresh
entries.desc: Installs, removes and updates packages (Fedora, RHEL 8+, AlmaLinux, Rocky).
entries.pitfall: dnf upgrade updates every package; dnf system-upgrade handles the move to the next Fedora release.

entries.name: dnf search · info · provides
entries.syn: dnf search <word> | dnf info <package> | dnf provides <file>
entries.desc: Finds a package, its details, or the package that provides a file.
entries.pitfall: dnf provides '*/bin/dig' returns bind-utils: handy when a command is not found.

entries.name: dnf history
entries.desc: dnf transaction log, with the ability to undo.
entries.pitfall: undo does not restore configuration files edited by hand.

entries.name: rpm -qa · rpm -qf
entries.desc: Queries the RPM database: installed packages, owner of a file, integrity check.

entries.name: systemctl
entries.desc: Controls systemd services.
entries.pitfall: enable does not start the service; add --now. daemon-reload is needed after editing a unit file.

entries.name: journalctl
entries.desc: Reads the systemd journal.
entries.pitfall: Without -b, the journal includes previous boots if persistence is enabled; -b -1 gives the previous boot.

entries.name: systemctl edit · systemd-analyze
entries.desc: Overrides a service without touching the original file, and analyzes boot time.
entries.pitfall: systemctl edit creates an override file in /etc/systemd/system/<service>.d/ that survives updates.

entries.name: df · du · lsblk
entries.desc: Disk space, folder sizes and disk layout.
entries.pitfall: Disk full while df shows free space: check inodes with df -i.

entries.name: LVM : pvs · vgs · lvs · lvextend
entries.desc: Shows LVM state and grows a logical volume together with its file system.
ex: sudo pvs; sudo vgs; sudo lvs
entries.pitfall: -r also resizes the file system (ext4, XFS). XFS can be grown but not shrunk.

entries.name: ssh · scp · rsync
entries.desc: Remote login and file copies.
entries.pitfall: A trailing / changes rsync's meaning: src/ copies the contents, src copies the folder. Test with -n (dry run), especially with --delete.

entries.name: top · htop · ps · free
entries.desc: Load, processes and memory.
entries.pitfall: 'available' memory matters, not 'free': the cache is reclaimable.

entries.name: firewall-cmd
entries.desc: Manages firewalld (Fedora, RHEL).
entries.pitfall: Without --permanent the rule disappears on reload; with --permanent it is only active after --reload.

entries.name: SELinux : getenforce · setsebool · restorecon · ausearch
entries.desc: SELinux state, booleans and restoring file contexts.
entries.pitfall: Do not disable SELinux to 'fix' something: read the AVC denials (ausearch, journalctl) and fix the context or the boolean.

entries.name: qm list · qm status
entries.desc: Lists the node's virtual machines and shows their state.
entries.pitfall: qm only shows VMs on the local node; for the whole cluster, use pvesh get /cluster/resources --type vm.

entries.name: qm start · shutdown · stop · reset
entries.desc: Starts, cleanly stops or abruptly cuts a VM.
entries.pitfall: stop is like pulling the plug (risk of corruption); shutdown needs the guest agent or ACPI.

entries.name: qm unlock
entries.desc: Removes the lock on a VM left stuck after an interrupted backup, clone or migration.
entries.pitfall: Check that no task is still running (pvesh get /nodes/<node>/tasks) before unlocking.

entries.name: qm clone · template · migrate
entries.syn: qm clone <vmid> <newid> --name <name> --full | qm template <vmid> | qm migrate <vmid> <node>
entries.desc: Clones a VM or template, converts to a template, migrates to another node.
entries.pitfall: A linked clone (without --full) depends on the template: do not delete it. --online requires shared storage or --with-local-disks.

entries.name: qm set · qm resize
entries.desc: Changes a VM's configuration or grows a disk.
entries.pitfall: A disk can only be grown. You then have to extend the partition and file system inside the guest.

entries.name: qm snapshot · rollback
entries.syn: qm snapshot <vmid> <name> | qm rollback <vmid> <name> | qm delsnapshot <vmid> <name>
entries.desc: Creates, restores or deletes a VM snapshot.
ex: qm snapshot 100 avant-maj --description 'Avant mise à jour'
entries.pitfall: A snapshot is not a backup: it stays on the same storage. Do not keep them for long.

entries.name: pct list · status · start
entries.syn: pct list | pct status <ctid> | pct start|shutdown|stop <ctid>
entries.desc: Lists and controls Proxmox LXC containers.

entries.name: pct enter · exec · push · pull
entries.syn: pct enter <ctid> | pct exec <ctid> -- <command> | pct push <ctid> <src> <dest>
entries.desc: Opens a shell in a container, runs a command in it or copies files into it.
entries.pitfall: pct enter gives a root shell in the container with no password: reserve it for the node's administrators.

entries.name: pct create · resize · set
entries.desc: Creates a container from a template, or changes its resources.
ex: pveam update && pveam available --section system | head
entries.pitfall: The exact template name changes with every release: list it with pveam available and download it with pveam download.

entries.name: pvesh get · create
entries.desc: Calls the Proxmox REST API from the command line.
entries.pitfall: pvesh usage <path> shows the parameters an API route accepts.

entries.name: vzdump
entries.desc: Backs up a VM or container.
entries.pitfall: A backup is only reliable if you have tested the restore (qmrestore, pct restore).

entries.name: qmrestore · pct restore
entries.desc: Restores a VM or container from a vzdump backup.
entries.pitfall: Restoring over an existing ID overwrites it: add --unique to regenerate the MAC addresses.

entries.name: pvecm status · nodes
entries.syn: pvecm status | pvecm nodes | pvecm expected <n>
entries.desc: State of the Proxmox cluster and quorum.
entries.pitfall: pvecm expected 1 forces quorum on a degraded cluster: use it only for troubleshooting, never as routine.

entries.name: pveversion · pveam · pvesm
entries.desc: Installed versions, container templates and storages.
